counters.name: poll_calls
counters.semantics: Number of generated suspend-frame poll function invocations, including inline child polls.

counters.name: cooperative_yields
counters.semantics: Number of task.yield_now suspension boundaries that returned PENDING.

counters.name: frame_allocations
counters.semantics: Logical heap or slab allocations for coroutine frames after allocator warm-up; stack and embedded child frames do not count.

counters.name: frame_drops
counters.semantics: Started coroutine frames whose idempotent drop plan executed for the first time.

counters.name: peak_live_frames
counters.semantics: Maximum simultaneously started and not-yet-dropped coroutine frames.

counters.name: local_retain
counters.semantics: Non-atomic ARC retain primitive operations executed by the measured program.

counters.name: local_release
counters.semantics: Non-atomic ARC release primitive operations executed by the measured program.

counters.name: live_timers
counters.semantics: Current owner-local timer registrations at the observation point.
